basic_details.job_title: PM SHRI JNV Puri Recruitment 2026 - Walkin for TGT, Matron and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: PM SHRI Navodaya Vidyalaya Puri has published the TGT (Computer Science), ATL Facilitator, and Matron Notification 2026 on the official website, https://navodaya.gov.in/. The recruitment drive aims to fill 5 vacancies under these posts. Candidates meeting the prescribed age criteria (up to 50 years for TGT and ATL Facilitator, and 35–55 years for Matron) and possessing the required qualifications, including BCA, Computer Science/IT degrees, B.E./B.Tech., B.Ed., CTET Paper-II, M.Sc., or Class X as applicable to the respective posts, are eligible to attend the walk-in interview on 30 July 2026.

content_sections.heading: PM SHRI JNV Puri Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 5 vacancies are available – 1 for TGT (Computer Science), 1 for ATL Facilitator, and 3 for Matron.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: TGT (Computer Science): Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Application (BCA) with at least 50% marks OR Graduation in Computer Science/IT with at least 50% marks OR BE/B.Tech. (Computer Science/Information Technology) with at least 50% marks; Qualified in CTET (Paper-II); Bachelor’s Degree in Education from NCTE recognized institution with at least 50% marks OR Three year integrated B.Ed.-M.Ed. OR Four years Integrated Degree including B.Ed. component. ATL Facilitator: M.Sc in Physics with specialization in Electronics/Robotics/IT OR B-Tech (Electronics & Communication Engineering /Robotics/IT/Comp Science/AI). Matron: Class X pass, Married females, which includes widows or divorcees without encumbrances.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: TGT: Maximum 50 years. ATL Facilitator: Maximum 50 years. Matron: Minimum 35 years, Maximum 55 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: TGT: 34125/- per month ATL Facilitator: 30000/- per month Matron: Minimum wages for MTS Unskilled as per Govt of India Rules

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.
